description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for Sword of Hope — Godot 4 GDScript (273 files, ~52K LOC)

rules.name: Duplicate function definitions across directories
rules.message: Function with same name defined in multiple directories — parallel implementations cause confusion
rules.suggestion: Consolidate to a single implementation in a shared module; delete the duplicate

rules.name: AudioStreamPlayer node with null stream
rules.message: AudioStreamPlayer has null stream — no audio will play
rules.suggestion: Assign a valid AudioStream resource: $AudioStreamPlayer.stream = preload('res://assets/audio/sfx.ogg')

rules.name: Texture reference to missing file
rules.message: Texture path references a file that does not exist in the project
rules.suggestion: Verify the .png/.webp file exists at the res:// path, or add the missing asset

rules.name: Large function complexity (52K LOC codebase risk)
rules.message: Function has high cyclomatic complexity — hard to maintain in a 52K LOC codebase
rules.suggestion: Extract branches into helper functions; consider a state machine for complex logic

rules.name: Class defined but never referenced outside its directory
rules.message: class_name declared but never referenced outside its own directory — possible orphaned code
rules.suggestion: Verify the class is still needed; if part of a deprecated system, remove it
